symptom: create or modify adding a parameter between two stored ones gave it the position of the next stored parameter (both 300;53), so the icons overlapped in Studio Pro and DESCRIBE carried the overlap into later rebuilds.
cause: mfmutator.setParameters inserts the rebuilt parameter document as is; its RelativeMiddlePoint is the position derived from its index, while the stored parameters after it keep their stored positions and are not shifted.
fix: placeAddedParameters: an added parameter whose position another parameter holds goes after the rightmost parameter, at the derived row's pitch (ParameterPitch's formula). A free slot is kept, and stored parameters never move.
insight: A splice mixes two coordinate sources: stored positions for what it keeps and derived ones for what it adds. Anything added must be checked against the stored layout, not against the rebuild's own, where it was correct.
test: mdl/backend/mfmutator/header_added_param_position_2185_test.go TestSetHeader_AddedParameterDoesNotLandOnAStoredOne (control: an appended parameter in a free slot keeps it)
